Fathom pedicle-based retractor

Assembly and insertion, step by step

What each control does

gold hexBlade length. Clockwise longer, anticlockwise shorter. One turn = 2.8 mm.
black squareC/C blade claw. Anticlockwise opens, clockwise closes. Turn it with the Medial Blade Inserter. Also where the inserter grips the medial blade.
black toe hexNext to each blade on the base arm. Clockwise toward + adds toe.
silver lateral hexArm spacing along the rack. Slider on D: left clockwise, right anticlockwise to distract. Slider on C: left anticlockwise, right clockwise to compress.
silver hex by ReleaseMoves the Medial Extension Arm toward midline: right arm clockwise, left arm anticlockwise. Also used to remove the MEA.
silver pyramid sliderThree positions: D distract, unlock, C compress.
black locking sliderLocks a blade gear into its arm. Unlock to fit or remove a blade.
Medial Blade InserterSilver button frees the medial blade sweep (up to 30° each way). Black end button releases the inserter.
LimitsMEA distracts 23 mm max; triangle shows at 3 mm left. Shank Driver and Alignment Clip don’t fit a blade extended past 105 mm.

The guide calls the wrench both “Base Wrench” and “Retractor Wrench”. The tray has 2 × Retractor Wrench, Small.
